description.zh:
要删除的资产组ID。
> 您可以调用[ListHostGroups](~~201307~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the asset group that you want to delete.

> You can call the [ListHostGroups](~~201307~~) operation to query the asset group ID.

description.zh:
要删除的资产组所在堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the bastion host whose asset group you want to delete.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the bastion host ID.

description.zh:
要删除的资产组所在堡垒机的地域ID。
> 地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host whose asset group you want to delete.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

descriptions.zh:
本接口用于删除单个主机组。当堡垒机上某个主机组内的所有主机不在需要通过堡垒机运维时，您可以使用本接口删除该主机组。

### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Deletes a single host group. If all hosts in a host group no longer need to be managed through Bastionhost, you can delete the host group using this operation.

### Limits

You can call this operation up to 10 times per second per account. If the number of the calls per second exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered. As a result, your business may be affected. We recommend that you take note of the limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost delete-host-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-group-id 2 --region cn-hangzhou
